value.objective: Coordinate patient care, scheduling, and billing in one system.

functional_requirements.title: Register a patient
functional_requirements.description: Staff can create a patient record with demographics.
functional_requirements.rationale: Nothing else in the system works without a patient record.

functional_requirements.title: Book an appointment
functional_requirements.description: Staff book a patient with a doctor at a time slot.
functional_requirements.rationale: Scheduling is the primary daily workflow.

non_functional_requirements.title: Patient data confidentiality
non_functional_requirements.description: Records are accessible only to authorised roles.

user_stories.i_want: to book an appointment for a patient
user_stories.so_that: the patient is seen by the right doctor
acceptance_criteria: Booking a free slot succeeds and returns a confirmation.
Booking an already-taken slot is rejected with a conflict error.

open_questions: Which regulatory regime applies to this deployment?
value.reasoning: The brief names patients, appointments, billing, doctors, and operations. I scoped the MVP to patient registration and appointment booking because billing depends on both and neither exists yet. Clinical data drove the confidentiality requirement; the regulatory regime is not stated, so I raised it as an open question rather than assuming one.
